name: Abhinav Parameshwaran
title: AI Engineer | Machine Learning & Data Science | LLM Systems & Agentic AI
summary: AI Engineer with expertise in LLM systems, agentic AI, and machine learning. Brings hands-on experience building production ML pipelines, RAG systems, and multi-agent architectures, combined with specialized knowledge in computational biology and bioinformatics. Currently at Keck School of Medicine of USC developing intelligent data processing systems and AI-powered research tools.

experience.title: AI Data Scientist
experience.company: Keck School of Medicine of USC
bullets: Designed and deployed automated data processing pipelines handling 10TB+ of scRNA-seq and PacBio sequencing data, supporting computational biology research across 3+ active studies and reducing analysis turnaround time by ~40%.
Built a classification model for anomaly detection in genomic data achieving 92% accuracy; automated erroneous sample flagging to reduce manual QC overhead by 10%.

Developed a custom statistical QC algorithm for PacBio sequencing validation using sex-marker expression as ground truth, reducing false-positive variants by 99% and saving thousands in downstream lab validation costs.

Built LLM-based research assistant tooling using domain-specific prompt engineering and configured Claude workflows with computational biology context to accelerate researcher dry-lab tasks (literature review, code generation, multi-omics interpretation).
Implemented multi-sample scRNA-seq integration and normalization pipelines; standardized protocols to eliminate batch effects across pooled donor samples and streamline downstream analysis.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Developed Python automation utilities and REST APIs using Flask; integrated SQL/Oracle databases, reducing processing time by 25%.
Wrote pytest unit tests and resolved 50+ production bugs; contributed to CI/CD pipelines for enterprise clients.
Supported 5+ enterprise client projects in Agile environment; delivered 20+ technical documents and requirement specifications.
Refactored legacy Python modules and optimized SQL database queries, reducing API response latency by ~150ms for client portal services.

projects.name: Multi-Agent Trip Concierge & Logic Supervisor
projects.description: Built a supervised multi-agent system using LangGraph conditional routing and Pinecone RAG to ingest unstructured chat logs and resolve scheduling conflicts under venue constraints. Implemented supervisor pattern with state-aware routing across specialized agents and benchmarked conflict resolution across multiple venue-type combinations.

projects.name: AI Teaching Assistant
projects.description: Built a multi-agent RAG chatbot using Pinecone and MCP to support course-content Q&A through a React frontend serving 300+ students. Integrated MCP for dynamic course material ingestion and implemented response grading and user feedback loops for continuous model refinement.

projects.name: Social Media Engagement Prediction (DUNEs of Influence)
projects.description: Designed a deep learning model to predict social media engagement trained on a custom dataset of 50K+ posts, outperforming baseline models by 25%. Experimented with transformer-based embeddings and temporal features, achieving 0.78 RMSE on hold-out test set and deploying inference API for real-time predictions.
